results: 1. witnessed description of the event: the right arm reaches and grasps and takes a DYSTONIC posture during the movement, despite a manual muscle testing score of 1 - the movement is ictal, not voluntary
2. head injury history: traumatic brain injury after being thrown from a horse
3. neurological examination between events: right-sided hemiplegia, manual muscle testing grade 1
4. interictal EEG: repetitive sharp waves predominantly in the LEFT FRONTAL area during sleep, with pseudocontinuous 3 Hz slow waves in the same region on awakening
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Post-traumatic focal epilepsy of the left frontal lobe, secondary to prior traumatic brain injury, with associated right hemiplegia from the underlying structural lesion.

1. Non-lesional (genetic/idiopathic) focal epilepsy arising from the left frontal lobe
2. Frontal lobe epilepsy due to a post-traumatic encephalomalacic/gliotic scar in the left frontal region
3. Epilepsia partialis continua (Rasmussen-related) involving the left motor cortex
dx: Post-traumatic focal epilepsy of the left frontal lobe, secondary to prior traumatic brain injury, with associated right hemiplegia from the underlying structural lesion.
